# Compliance ticket for opi-q5k.8

Source check: opi-q5k.8 (keybindings.test.ts audit)

## Gap summary

All three upstream tests in tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/keybindings.test.ts verify a single invariant — **user rebinds must not evict unrelated default bindings**. Our apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/keybindings_test.exs does not assert this invariant.

## Required tests

Add the following to keybindings_test.exs:

### 1. Sibling default preserved when a binding is rebound
Mirrors upstream "does not evict selector confirm when input submit is rebound":
    kb = Keybindings.new(%{"tui.input.submit" => ["enter", "ctrl+enter"]})
    assert Keybindings.get_keys(kb, "tui.input.submit") == ["enter", "ctrl+enter"]
    assert Keybindings.get_keys(kb, "tui.select.confirm") == ["enter"]

### 2. Shared-key sibling retains its default after an additive rebind
Mirrors upstream "does not evict cursor bindings when another action reuses the same key":
    kb = Keybindings.new(%{"tui.select.up" => ["up", "ctrl+p"]})
    assert Keybindings.get_keys(kb, "tui.select.up") == ["up", "ctrl+p"]
    assert Keybindings.get_keys(kb, "tui.editor.cursorUp") == ["up"]

### 3. Defaults preserved even when a user conflict exists
Mirrors upstream "still reports direct user binding conflicts without evicting defaults":
    kb = Keybindings.new(%{"tui.input.submit" => ["ctrl+x"], "tui.select.confirm" => ["ctrl+x"]})
    # conflict assertion already covered in existing "detects user-introduced conflicts"
    assert Keybindings.get_keys(kb, "tui.editor.cursorLeft") == ["left", "ctrl+b"]

Confirm the actual default values against the `TUI_KEYBINDINGS` (or equivalent Elixir module constant) before hardcoding — upstream literal values (["enter"], ["up"], ["left", "ctrl+b"]) should match our Elixir defaults. If they diverge, use our Elixir defaults and document the divergence.

## Re-comparison (required)

After the tests land, re-read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/keybindings.test.ts top-to-bottom and confirm every upstream `it(...)` block has an equivalent in keybindings_test.exs. Post a final comment on this ticket with that re-comparison before closing.

## Deps
Blocks opi-q5k.1 (acceptance gate).

comments.text: Done. 3 tests locked in under 'no-eviction of defaults' describe in keybindings_test.exs. Implementation was already correct (build/2 iterates defaults per-action). Re-comparison: upstream keybindings.test.ts has 3 it(...) blocks, all three now have Elixir equivalents.

title: Port keybindings.test.ts gap: defaults not evicted by user rebinds
